task.title: L12.30 history-integrity and action-identity residuals N1-N5 from the L12.29 re-QC
task.objective: Owner request of 2026-10-06, on the Windows development machine: reconcile the authoritative Beads/Dolt tracker with the L12.27/L12.28 records that were hand-edited into .beads/issues.jsonl on a host without bd, record the L12.29 re-QC verdict (FAIL, N1-N5 reproduced), create the next P1 child under L12 and implement it. N1: look-alike history past the 1024 bound was replaced by the current walk, so an earlier look-alike lost protection. N2: a truncated or failed walk silently weakened the kept history. N3: concurrent instances sharing a winner record could erase each other's look-alikes through read, merge, write. N1 to N3 are one history-integrity contract: overflow, truncation, failure and concurrency never turn incomplete history into trusted history. N4/N5: a shared generic aria-label, data-action or textless title was accepted as the action identity of a similar-rows loop although it does not tell the picked action apart from its siblings. Each gets red-first permanent coverage and mutation proof. Earlier P1 fixes stay fixed. Phase L hardening is not closed by this task.

acceptance.description: The Beads database, not the JSONL, holds L12.27 closed, L12.28 closed FAIL, L12.29 closed FAIL with N1-N5, and a new P1 child for N1-N5; .beads/issues.jsonl is regenerated by bd export and verify:roadmap-dashboard reports Sources agree.

N1 overflow, N2 truncated or failed walk and N3 concurrent stale write each reproduce a wrong recovery red first on 33e6adfd and refuse after the fix; the history is complete or unproven, never silently weakened. Storage bounded, older records fail closed. Mutation tested.

N4/N5: a generic aria-label, data-action or textless title shared by every row action never names a loop; the real StepExecutor clicks exactly the intended action and rows, or the loop is refused, for Approve to Reject, Approve to Unapprove, a sibling added after generation and wrapper changes; a genuinely distinguishing label still loops. Red first, mutation tested.

Every earlier P1 repro stays fixed; coverage 0 WRONG, acceptance at least 11/14, recovery, recorder, runner, Element Spy, mock-site, build, script typecheck and verifier classification green on Windows; overhead within the L12.29 matched baseline.

history.released_reason: L12.27 closed, L12.28 and L12.29 replayed into the Beads DB, L12.30 created as awkit-djnl.21.30, JSONL exported
